For a gluten-free all-purpose flour substitute that yields a nice, airy loaf, the best option is a high-quality gluten-free all-purpose flour blend that includes xanthan gum or guar gum. These binders mimic the elasticity of gluten, helping the dough rise and maintain structure. Look for blends labeled "1-to-1" or "measure-for-measure" for ease of use. Popular brands like King Arthur Measure for Measure or Bob's Red Mill 1-to-1 Baking Flour work well. Avoid using single-grain flours like almond or coconut flour alone, as they lack the starch structure needed for a traditional bread texture.
